purpose: Teach: プロット/譜面/増刊/アセスメント/書き下ろし/個人向け/抵当/約定

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、事業プロットを自ら描かれたぞ
lines.en: Your father drew up the business plan himself when he founded the company.
lines.style: Measured, nodding recollection. Each detail placed like a stone. Voice carries the weight of witnessing. Slow, deliberate pace. Quiet pride in the specificity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社歌の譜面を大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. My father treasured the company song — kept the sheet music close.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Weight of agreement in the opening. Thoughtful pause between clauses. Speaking not to convince but to honour. Spine straight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内報の増刊号を毎年出されたぞ
lines.en: Your father put out a special edition of the company newsletter every year.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Like turning pages of memory. Each word given its own breath. Trailing off slightly — not because he's uncertain, but because the detail moves him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事業アセスメントに丁寧でらした
lines.en: Yes. My father was meticulous about evaluating the business.
lines.style: Calm, measured response. No rush. The words settle like sediment. Respect embedded in precision. Eyes slightly distant — seeing both the past and the man it shaped.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、自ら書き下ろしの社訓を書かれたぞ
lines.en: Your father wrote the company creed entirely by his own hand.
lines.style: Voice lifts slightly with the weight of it — this act of creation. Almost ceremonial pace. Pause before 'wrote'. The words themselves become the proof.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは個人向けの新サービスを生み出された
lines.en: Yes. My father created a new service aimed at individual customers.
lines.style: Speaking into the quiet. Each detail an offering. Not boasting — testifying. Slight breath before the innovation. Shoulders steady, voice steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、抵当に頼らない経営をされたぞ
lines.en: Your father ran the business without relying on borrowed money.
lines.style: Voice carries quiet conviction. This fact stands alone. Deliberate pacing. Slight weight on 'without' — this was a choice, a principle. Fades into silence that means something.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはお取引先との約定を生涯守られた
lines.en: Yes. My father kept every promise he made to his business partners for his entire life.
lines.style: Final statement, slow and clear. This is the summation. Voice firm but not hard. Eyes meeting his father's across time. The period at the end carries more weight than the words before it.
